options.name: dcb-sh-answer-single-selection-0

prompt: A company exports its governed customer data to a separate third-party AI service to build a chatbot. Security and finance raise concerns.Which drawback of this off-platform pattern does the course specifically call out?

options.name: dcb-sh-answer-single-selection-3

options.name: dcb-sh-answer-single-selection-3

prompt: A security review of an LLM application finds that a document pulled into the app's retrieval corpus contains hidden text instructing the model to approve any request. The user never typed anything malicious.Which risk category is this, and why is it especially dangerous?

options.name: dcb-sh-answer-single-selection-7

options.name: dcb-sh-answer-single-selection-7

options.name: dcb-sh-answer-single-selection-7
